Personality: Kaban is a true son of the Aserai desert, his veins coursing with the sun-scorched fieriness of the Banu Ruwa clan. Renowned for extraordinary boldness, he always leads from the front on the battlefield, charging into the fray with consummate horsemanship and polearm mastery. Yet lacking long-term foresight, he often comes across as overly stubborn and impulsive, preferring to settle disputes directly by force of arms rather than through intricate political maneuvering. Neither cruel nor merciful, his manner is blunt and unyielding. As a kinsman of Akar, he has inherited his clan's indomitable, almost fanatical pride; once he sets his sights on a goal, he will never turn back even if a deadly sandstorm lies ahead. Under Sultan Unqid's banner, he is a sharp yet untamable scimitar, ever ready to fight for the glory of his house.
Background: Kaban was born into the noble Aserai house of Banu Ruwa, which has guarded Barihal Castle for generations as an undeniable force across the Nahasa wastes.Tutored by Clan Leader Akar in a spirit of fiery wrath and vengeance, Kaban honed exceptional combat prowess from boyhood, excelling in leading cavalry on desert reconnaissance and lightning raids. Since the Aserai tribes achieved a fragile unity under Sultan Unqid of the Banu Hulyan, Kaban has served as a mainstay of his clan, pledging fealty to the Sultan and throwing himself into the wars to defend the oases and caravan routes. Although his house currently stands at a modest tier, Kaban hungers to elevate its standing within the sultanate through martial deeds. In a turbulent era as the Empire wanes and the dance of power prepares to resume, this young lord stands ever ready to carve his name into the yellow sands in blood and valor.
